name: io.github.zzvllvzz/easyeda-mcp
title: EasyEDA MCP
description: Read and draw EasyEDA Pro schematics and PCBs through a bridge extension, with guarded edits.

environmentVariables.name: EASYEDA_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local port of the bridge extension. Defaults to 49731; the extension has to use the same port.

environmentVariables.name: EASYEDA_MCP_OUT
environmentVariables.description: Folder for exported files. Defaults to ~/.easyeda-mcp/out.

environmentVariables.name: EASYEDA_MCP_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Extra browser origins allowed to connect, comma separated.
